blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Most surfers in the World Surf League (WSL) Philippines Pro Championship Tour (CT) in Siargao will be meeting the famous right-hander for the first time. Jayuard Alciso has been reading it since he was a boy. The 21-year-old Siargaonon is one of four Filipino wildcards for the Philippines. Presented by the Philippine Sports Commission, the first CT event ever held in the country will be staged at Cloud 9 from Oct. 31 to Nov. 10. Four-time Siargao International Surfing Cup champion John Mark “Marama” Tokong goes straight into the main draw. Alciso, Noah Arkfeld, and Mara Lopez will […]...
